page.layout: Running head centred at top; page number top right. Two columns of list-like lines, left column then right column, with a catchword-like line "Menda-" at the foot right.

main_text.l: Ferum, malignum, immite, omne compositum ex male, ut maleficium, maledictio.
Oblivio inconsiderata eorum, quæ mortis sunt.

page.notes: Page is a two-column list; the running head is partly worn. Lines were split across columns in the scan; the final word "Menda-" is a catchword-style hyphenated word at the foot right. Some words in the list are uncertain due to faded print.
